fact: A PressAfrik investigation reported that more than two years after President Sall's June 2021 instruction, apart from the Ministry of Health at 80% of its transfer, no public or private institution had migrated its data to Diamniadio.
title: Souveraineté numérique du Sénégal : le vrai, le faux, le flou du Datacenter de Diamniadio (Enquête)
